segments.text: And the famine was sore in the land.
And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them,

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: Go again, buy us a little food.
And Judah spake unto him, saying,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: And Israel said,
Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me,

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
And they said,

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

footnotes.text: + could…: Heb. knowing could we know

segments.text: And Judah said unto Israel his father,

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

segments.speaker: Judah
segments.text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
And their father Israel said unto them,

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

segments.speaker: Israel
segments.text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

footnotes.text: + If…: or, And I, as I have been, etc.

segments.text: ¶ And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house,

segments.speaker: Joseph
segments.text: Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in;
that he may seek occasion against us,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

footnotes.text: + seek…: Heb. roll himself upon us

segments.text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And said,
O sir,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

footnotes.text: + we…: Heb. coming down we came down

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And he said,
Peace be to you,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: fear not:
your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

footnotes.text: + I had…: Heb. your money came to me

segments.text: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
¶ And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
And he asked them of their welfare, and said,

segments.speaker: Joseph
segments.text: Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

footnotes.text: + Is your…: Heb. Is there peace to your father?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And they answered,
Thy servant our father is in good health,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: he is yet alive.
And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said,

segments.speaker: Joseph
segments.text: Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me?
And he said,

segments.speaker: Joseph
segments.text: God be gracious unto thee, my son.
And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Set on bread.

And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs.
And they drank, and were merry with him.
